Tooltip_SQP_Build: Fixed four-facing portal. Each gate consumes 8 small metal sheets, 4 metal pipes, 8 electric wires, 16 electronics scrap, 1 expensive camera and 1 handheld walkie-talkie (any vanilla handheld model). Requires Electrical 4 and Welding 3. The screwdriver, blowtorch and welding mask are retained; no torch fuel is consumed. Install car batteries separately after construction.
